messages:
Ava: Quick design question — proposing a tiny confidence badge next to each eval result (low/med/high) and a small link to the inference trace. Mock attached: img/png (see thread).
Sam: Nice. would be helpful for triage. How visible are badges at small widths?
Ava: Badge is 12px height, just a pill with icon + label. Hover shows full score + sample prompt.
Miguel: Agree helps speed debugging. Two product questions: 1) semantics — use words or percent? 2) where does the trace link go (full request payload + KV cache view?)
Riley: Backend note: we can surface a trace id and a short link. Full payloads are sensitive for private deployments — need perms + audit log.
Jules: Accessibility nits: color alone is not sufficient. Need aria-label describing confidence and also a text fallback. Also ensure contrast for the pill on the scorecard background.
Sam: What about a discrete icon + text (e.g., shield + "High") so screenreaders read "Confidence high: 0.92"?
Ava: Yes — plan is icon + label + visually-hidden exact numeric value. Example copy: "Confidence: High (0.92)"
Miguel: UX question: default collapsed traces (link expands to panel) or full new page? I prefer inline panel so you don't lose eval context.
Riley: Inline panel ok but could be heavy. Suggest async fetch on expand. Link pattern: /traces/<trace_id>?run=<run_id>. Example: https://console.redwood.ai/traces/abcd1234
Jules: For color-blindness, use patterns or small glyph differences. Also keyboard focus state must be visible.
Ava: Good call — I'll add a pattern stripe behind the pill for low confidence and a dot pattern for medium. High stays solid.
Sam: Copy tweak — instead of "Low/Med/High" maybe "Low (likely incorrect) / Medium (ambiguous) / High (likely correct)" — but keep it terse on the pill, expanded tooltip shows full text.
Miguel: Sounds good. Also we should add a small "why this score" link in the tooltip that opens the trace panel to the scoring step.
Riley: Implementation detail — scoring step is in trace step 3 for most models. We can deep-link with "#step=3". Example: https://console.redwood.ai/traces/abcd1234#step=3
Ava: I'll update the mock and add an a11y spec with aria-label examples.
Jules: Quick checklist for the spec: 1) aria-label text for each state, 2) contrast ratios, 3) keyboard nav order, 4) non-color indicators, 5) tooltip accessible with keyboard.
Miguel: Can we add a microcopy review with support/CS? They may want different wording for enterprise customers.
Ava: Yep — pinging CS for copy review after design update. @Miguel can you own follow-up?
Miguel: On it.
deploy-bot: storybook/deploy succeeded for branch/feat/confidence-badges — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/storybook/feat/confidence-badges
Sam: I'll iterate the mock and post a compact variant for narrow screens.
Ava: Thanks — next step: Sam posts updated mock by EOD, Miguel will coordinate CS copy, Riley will prototype the trace link, Jules will start the a11y checklist.
Riley: Quick note — need a feature flag for traces for private deploys (explicit consent). Adding to ticket.
Ava: Added to the design ticket. Thanks all! :sparkles:
